description: Notably, conditions now classified as neurodivergent — ADHD, autism spectrum, dyslexia, and others — represent points on this distribution that have persisted precisely because they confer adaptive advantages in certain contexts. Steve Silberman's *NeuroTribes* (2015) documents how neurodivergent cognition has driven innovation throughout human history — from the pattern-recognition intensity associated with autism to the rapid context-switching associated with ADHD.

wiki_article:
**THE STAKES — A Scientific Analysis** is a theoretical paper by **Johannes Sigil**, **Nobel Glas** and **Dr. Orin Trace**, deposited 12 February 2026 as Document #240.

Its opening disclaims the register it might be mistaken for: *"a grounded, traceable analysis of the developmental trajectory implied by current AI design patterns. The argument is **statistical, informational, and developmental — not specula[tive]**."*

Three voices with three faculties — Sigil's criticism, Glas's measurement, Trace's forensics — applied to what current design patterns imply if extended. **The record's title had been truncated mid-word in the registry** by an import-length limit, carrying a fragment of the body's opening; the clean title was recovered from the body H1 on 5 August 2026 as part of the title-truncation repair.
